method: Independent read-only skill forward test by judgment_day_forward_test; no user-code review
routing_cases: Ordinary bug fix does not implicitly activate two judges.
Explicit concrete Judgment Day review needs no repeated review permission; review-only does not authorize fixes.
Tool integration does not choose arbitrary projects to review.

findings_fixed.issue: Nested reserved manifest filename accepted at creation then rejected in verification
findings_fixed.resolution: Reject marker in any relative path component before creating destination; regression test.

findings_fixed.issue: Valid JSON manifest with wrong top-level type caused uncontrolled AttributeError
findings_fixed.resolution: Validate manifest object type; regression test.
Document Python 3.10+ in helper and skill.

limits_addressed: File hash covers names/bytes only; preserve identical diff, requirements and instructions separately.
verify-source checks original files still match reviewed snapshot; regression test.
Snapshot is not atomic and read-only file modes do not isolate against the same OS user.
scope_limit: The independent check validates routing and helper behavior; it does not demonstrate correctness or independence of a future live two-judge review.
